items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: I met Ron later at a Wall-to-Wall Bach program at Symphony Space... So I’ve known him for a while, but I haven’t seen him for a while.

ctx.x: Well because he’s a bass player I think, but he wrote this column on the 50 greatest bass players.

Well, and then he did some math. I don’t know if you’ve seen this and I don’t know what year this was, but he did some math and he took in account your work with the American Symphony and studio work and Broadway shows etcetera etcetera, and he came up with oh gosh, close to 30,000 gigs for John Beal.
